trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied params key may bind to an action argument is decided by matching the key against action.arguments; arguments with public?: false must only be settable via private_arguments/set_private_argument, never from params. At the pinned commit the string-key lookup and both has_argument? clauses in Ash.Changeset skip the public? filter.

landing_point.why: Summary says private arguments settable from user input; Ash.Changeset.cast_params is the params->argument binder behind for_create/for_update, and its atom-key helper at :3518-3520 already shows the public? filter, so the asymmetric string clause at :3522-3524 is found immediately.

fix_sites.entry_point: Ash.Changeset.for_create/for_update/for_destroy/for_action (and Ash.create/update/destroy, code interfaces, Ash.bulk_create) with string-keyed params -> handle_params -> cast_params (changeset.ex:3171-3173, 3482)

Ash.Changeset.fully_atomic_changeset/4 (changeset.ex:802, 843) -> atomic_params (changeset.ex:1776, 1807), used by Ash.update atomic path (lib/ash/actions/update/update.ex:100) and Ash.bulk_update/bulk_destroy atomic strategy (lib/ash/actions/update/bulk.ex:128, lib/ash/actions/destroy/bulk.ex:168); atom and string keys
fix_sites.module_kind: core library: atomic changeset builder (same file, different function family)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both published sites are private helpers in lib/ash/changeset/changeset.ex (3522-3532). The atomic path (fully_atomic_changeset -> atomic_params at changeset.ex:1772-1808) is the closest thing to an out-of-scope-looking route, but it lives in the same file and uses the same helper.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Bulk update/destroy base_changeset only builds a template changeset whose per-record changesets are re-cast through handle_params (now filtered), so a solver can argue the base changeset is internal and never persisted; assume_casted? is a trusted-caller option.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Private arguments must keep working when set via the private_arguments option / set_private_argument (do_set_private_argument finds args by atom or string name with no public filter) and via set_argument from changes; also has_argument? is reused to classify keyword validation errors as InvalidArgument, so adding public? there (as the published fix does) turns errors on private-argument fields into InvalidChanges. An over-broad fix that filters public? inside set_argument/do_set_argument or the shared find in do_set_private_argument breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: string-keyed params map ("secret" => v) via cast_params (changeset.ex:3522-3524)
atom-keyed params (secret: v) via atomic_params, which had no public? filter at all (changeset.ex:3526-3528, 1807)
assume_casted?: true atomic branch (changeset.ex:1776-1777) is also covered because it uses the same has_argument?

O7_producer.where: lib/ash/resource/transformers/cache_action_inputs.ex:23-27,53 persists {:action_inputs, action} including every argument name (atom and string) regardless of public?; read by Ash.Resource.Info.action_input? at lib/ash/resource/info.ex:715-721, which is the first gate in cast_params (lib/ash/changeset/changeset.ex:3459). Because the cache admits private names, the gate passes and the decision falls to get_action_argument.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Ash.bulk_update stream strategy: base_changeset binds input keys (atom or string) to any action argument without public?, overriding private_arguments via set_arguments, then pre-templates change/validation opts (arg(...)) from those arguments; templated opts are not re-filled per record.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: base changeset is only a template; each record's changeset is re-cast through the now-fixed handle_params, so it looks internal.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file, lib/ash/actions/update/bulk.ex (~4000-line module); value flows via pre_template at lib/ash/actions/update/bulk.ex:1514-1524,1834-1846 and lib/ash/actions/update/bulk.ex:3964-3965

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Ash.bulk_destroy stream strategy: identical base_changeset argument binding without public?, followed by set_arguments after set_private_arguments_for_action and pre-templating of changes.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: destroy is a neighbouring action type and the base changeset looks like a template only.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: bulk_create/bulk_update/bulk_destroy with assume_casted?: true: Map.split(input, argument_names) where argument_names includes private arguments, written straight into changeset.arguments.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: assume_casted? is an option for trusted, pre-cast input, so it is not a user-input route.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a create-side base_changeset that pre-binds input keys to action.arguments for templating, like update/destroy
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: update and destroy bulk already do exactly this (update/bulk.ex:1748, destroy/bulk.ex:1318); a maintainer adding arg() templating to bulk create would copy it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a separate persisted public-inputs set that a new caller trusts, or that is built from all arguments
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the cache is already the first gate in cast_params and mixes public and private names; deriving another key set from it is natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a params-driven helper that reuses the do_set_private_argument name lookup (atom or string) for user input
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: same lookup idiom, no public? filter, already used for both shapes.
